title: The Secret Engineering Inside Your Car and Kitchen
false_sentence: Drive down any high-speed interstate, and you will notice heavy steel boxes welded onto the ends of metal guardrails right where traffic approaches.
correct_version: Guardrail end terminals are not welded to the guardrail beam. Instead, they are mounted so that during an end-on collision, the impact forces the terminal head to slide along the steel rail, extruding and flattening it to absorb energy.
why: Guardrail extruder terminals cannot be welded to the steel beam because they must be able to slide along or feed the rail through the terminal box during an impact to deform the metal and absorb kinetic energy.
